The '''rest energy''', often denoted by $E_0$, is the amount of energy embodied in [[mass]].

The above equation, known as the '''mass-energy equivalence formula''' and first formulated by [[Person:Albert Einstein]], is arguably the most famous equation in [[physics]], loved for its ground-breaking simplicity.
